Hi Markus (and Redwood team),

Thanks for the details and the sample manifest. A few quick answers and next steps: 

- Public SaaS + Private Offer: For the co-sell path you described, a public SaaS listing with private-offer support is acceptable. You do not need a separate public and private offer; we handle private offer creation from the public offer.

- Metering endpoints: No special latency constraints, but the endpoint must support TLS 1.2+ and return 200/202 on successful ingestion. Please include retry semantics (idempotent meter submissions) in your integration notes.

- Manifest format: JSON is fine. The sample you attached looks good, but we'll need the full schema fields populated for SKU IDs and pricing tiers.

Action items for Redwood (please upload to the publisher case):
- Full manifest with SKU IDs and pricing tiers (JSON)
- MPN proof and org identity (contoso_mpn_proof.pdf already received from Contoso — please upload your org docs)
- Validation checklist: we attached the required checklist (validation_checklist.pdf).

I've created case ID MPCASE-2027-98765 and attached a short checklist and the portal link. Once you upload the artifacts our validation team will run the technical gate (typically 3–5 business days). For co-sell metadata, include partnerTag and coSellEligible flags in the manifest.

Helpful links: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/marketplace/publish/managed-saas-offers
HubSpot reference: HUBSPOT-123456

Regards,
Marketplace Program
Azure Marketplace Publisher Support
marketplace@microsoft.com
